requirements.quote: With this option, an endpoint could send a PING frame (Section 19.2) periodically, which will cause the peer to restart its idle timeout period.
requirements.condition: An endpoint using the idle-timeout deferral option periodically sends a PING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: The peer restarts its idle timeout period.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send a PING frame and observe whether the peer's idle-timeout deadline is restarted.

requirements.quote: Sending a packet containing a PING frame restarts the idle timeout for this endpoint also if this is the first ack-eliciting packet sent since receiving a packet.
requirements.condition: The endpoint sends a packet containing a PING frame, and it is the first ack-eliciting packet sent since the endpoint received a packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The sending endpoint restarts its own idle timeout.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet history and the endpoint's idle-timeout deadline can be instrumented to verify that the qualifying transmission restarts the timer.

requirements.quote: Sending a PING frame causes the peer to respond with an acknowledgment, which also restarts the idle timeout for the endpoint.
requirements.condition: A peer receives a PING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: The peer responds with an acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a PING frame and inspect the peer's subsequent packets for an acknowledgment.

requirements.quote: Sending a PING frame causes the peer to respond with an acknowledgment, which also restarts the idle timeout for the endpoint.
requirements.condition: The endpoint receives the acknowledgment generated in response to its PING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint restarts its idle timeout.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver the acknowledgment and compare the endpoint's idle-timeout deadline before and after receipt.

requirements.quote: Application protocols that use QUIC SHOULD provide guidance on when deferring an idle timeout is appropriate.
requirements.required_behavior: The application protocol should provide guidance specifying when deferring an idle timeout is appropriate.
requirements.why_checkable: The application protocol specification can be inspected for guidance governing use of idle-timeout deferral.

requirements.quote: A connection will time out if no packets are sent or received for a period longer than the time negotiated using the max_idle_timeout transport parameter; see Section 10.
requirements.condition: No packets are sent or received on a connection for longer than the duration negotiated through the max_idle_timeout transport parameter.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled test can negotiate max_idle_timeout, suppress all packet transmission and reception beyond that duration, and observe whether the connection times out.
